errors.text_span: изброени в произволен ред според големината на площта през 2023 година, започвайки от най-голямата
errors.evidence: The description states that the vegetables are listed in an arbitrary order according to the area size in 2023. This is contradictory and inaccurate. The categories are not in an arbitrary order; they are sorted in descending order based on the 2023 values.
The description states the harvested area for potatoes in 2023 was 'a little over 8000 ha'. The chart shows this value is approximately 7000 ha.

errors.text_span: лук кромид-зрял е на трето място с около 2700 ха през 2022 и малко над 2500 ха през 2023 година
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly reports the values for 'лук кромид-зрял' (onions). The chart shows approximately 2500 ha for 2022 (not 2700 ha) and 3000 ha for 2023 (not 'a little over 2500 ha'). The values are inaccurate and appear to be partially swapped.

errors.text_span: градински грах - зелен, с малко над 500 ха
errors.evidence: The description states the area for 'градински грах - зелен' (garden peas) is 'a little over 500 ha'. The chart shows the values are approximately 800 ha (2023) and 900 ha (2022), both significantly more than 500 ha.

The description states the area for 'сладка царевица' (sweet corn) is 'about 600 ha'. The chart shows the values are approximately 900 ha (2023) and 1000 ha (2022), both significantly more than 600 ha.

errors.text_span: тикви и кратуни с под 1000 ха и през двете години
errors.evidence: The description claims the area for 'тикви и кратуни' (pumpkins and gourds) is 'under 1000 ha in both years'. The chart shows the value for 2022 is clearly above 1000 ha (approx. 1200 ha).

errors.text_span: Другите зеленчуци следват със значително по-малки площи
errors.evidence: The phrase 'significantly smaller areas' is an interpretation of the data rather than a neutral description of the values. The prompt asks to avoid such conclusions.

errors.text_span: някои от тях имат съвсем малки площи
errors.evidence: The phrase 'some of them have very small areas' is subjective and interpretative. The prompt requires objective description without such evaluative language.

errors.text_span: Някои култури имат много близки стойности между двете години, докато други, като картофите и пипер (вкл. лют), показват забележими разлики между 2022 и 2023 година.
errors.evidence: This sentence makes a comparative analysis between the years ('very close values', 'noticeable differences'), which is a form of interpretation that the prompt asks to avoid.
